errorCodes.meaning: No join request with the supplied id exists.
The request is not in the pending state, so it cannot be decided.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Response.description: The success response to a vtc/join-requests/decide request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/join-requests/decide/0.1#response.

roleVac.description: The role credential this decision issued: a Verifiable Authority Credential (`type` including `AuthorityCredential`) issued by the community with `issuerScope` `public`, whose `credentialSubject.authority` is `{ scope: <community DID>, actions: ["role:<name>"] }` — the shape vtc/vetting/vetters/grant/0.1 issues. Delivered inline alongside `vmc` and on the same reasoning. Present only where the decision admitted the applicant and granted a role. Formerly `roleVec`; roles are authority, not endorsements.

status.description: The request's post-decision state; echoes the decision.

vmc.description:
The membership credential issued by this decision, delivered inline. Present only where the decision admitted the applicant.

Inline because the alternative is worse: the applicant would poll for a status, learn they were admitted, and then fetch the credential separately — a second round trip whose only purpose is to collect something the community already had in hand when it decided.

Response.title: VTC Join-Requests Decide — response payload

decision.description: The operator's decision. `approved` admits the applicant as a member; `rejected` refuses them.

reason.description: Optional operator rationale, recorded in the audit trail alongside the decision. Most useful with `rejected`.
